correctness.rationale: The all-size proof uses a concrete structural witness at any triply internal vertex. On an r>=7 noncaterpillar exactly at most four leaf deletions destroy every witness, with equality if and only if its shape is F_r. Sequential uniform deletion telescopes to (k)_4/(n)_4 and the unique extremizer survives within its own family. Boundary k=n and n=6 are treated separately. The independent standalone checker passes all 184 noncaterpillar shape/sample-size cases through eleven leaves and 770 explicit induced-tree comparisons; it is not misused as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: It gives an exact all-n/all-k minimum probability of detecting noncaterpillar structure from uniform taxa, identifies a unique worst-case evolutionary tree shape at every proper sample size, proves the sharp six-leaf detection threshold, and quantifies a worst-case n^4 cost for independent six-taxon rarefaction. This is a motivated finite sampling-power barrier, not an arbitrary small graph count or known-table recomputation.
